claims.statement: Search guide declares FPT/GHEC/GHES and default open/created/assigned/mentioned filters. Accessible identity/query results are not complete target inventory or permission-independent absence evidence.

Web issue-page/dashboard advanced grammar supports explicit AND/OR, spaces as AND and parentheses up to five nesting levels. This grammar must not be conflated with Projects automation subset or silently assumed identical in all CLI/API adapters.

Assignee dropdown claims list of write users while assignment guide also permits commenters/read organization members. Dropdown completeness is not full eligible assignee set; exact identifier search and effective access require verification.

Labels comma syntax is OR and repeated label qualifiers AND; negative term prefix excludes. Type qualifier operates organizational issue classification; labels/types are not accepted work or enforced policy.

Issue-fields conditional resolves FPT/GHEC/GHES>=3.23; field names with spaces quoted, date/number comparisons and comma options supported. Field-qualified syntax distinct from form fields or Project-local custom columns.

CLI examples list no-assignee help-wanted-or-bug sorted creation and team-mention PRs. Actual list limits/pagination/version are not specified here; examples not executed and do not prove complete acquisition.

Author/involves/assignee and Copilot identity qualifiers distinguish participation from mention or acknowledged responsibility. Copilot search example unqualified at parent level does not prove GHES cloud-agent availability.

Linked-pr/linked-issue searches reflect closing references; completed/not-planned close reasons remain lifecycle metadata. Counts and query hits cannot independently certify accepted criteria or human authorization.

Ownership queries allow at most16 user/org qualifiers and unlimited repo qualifiers; OR example needs validated grouping to avoid unexpected state/type scope. Denominator must remain independently declared.
Review-none/required/approved/changes-requested, reviewed-by and direct/team requested filters describe review state, not verified current required reviewer satisfaction or native bypass protection.

Status success/failure/pending qualifiers describe all-success, any-error/failure and none-or-any-pending respectively. Status success cannot certify all required checks, freshness, test adequacy, deployment or recovery.
Merged/unmerged predicates are merge lifecycle, not accepted release. Sort options creation/update/comment/reaction and reset to Newest change presentation, not evidence freshness or data deletion.

URL auto-updates and sharing reproduces query/sort syntax but recipients still subject to access and changing underlying state. Same filter URL is not same complete result set, frozen snapshot or disclosure permission.
Full guide and shared context reviewed; outbound search reference is separate scope. No native query view, assignment, review requirement or status gate changed.
